passage.label: gives wealth purify himself; not anyone favor rewarded; only seeking countenance Lord Most High; going satisfied

arabicExcerpts.text: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعۡمَةٖ تُجۡزَىٰٓ

mainSubject.label: The righteous one identified as giving wealth to purify himself, not repaying a favour owed to anyone but seeking only the countenance of his Lord, the Most High — and he is going to be satisfied

subordinateSubjects.label: Not giving to repay anyone's favour
Seeking only the countenance of his Lord, the Most High
He is going to be satisfied

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Wealth given purely for self-purification without expectation of reciprocal favour
Satisfaction promised as the outcome of seeking the Lord's countenance alone

relationships.label: Seeking the countenance of the Most High as the sole motive excluding all social debt

notes: Wave 13 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the wealth-futility question at the point of falling (11) before the guidance-incumbency declaration opens (12); P2 ends with the righteous avoidance statement (17) before the purification-giving description begins (18); P3 runs through the four-verse portrait of sincere giving culminating in satisfaction (18-21).
